def check_readouts(data, out, t):
    y = out['predicted_strain']
    y0 = data['strain_0']
    crit = data['critical_strain']
    sec = out['secant_compliance']
    cross = out['hazard_crossing_times']
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sec, (y[:, -1] - y0) / np.maximum(abs(data['stress_hold_0']), 0.5), rtol=0, atol=1e-13)
    manual = []
    for (vals, target) in zip(np.column_stack((y0, y)), crit):
        j = next((j for (j, v) in enumerate(vals) if v >= target), None)
        grid = np.r_[0.0, t]
        manual.append(t[-1] if j is None else 0.0 if j == 0 else np.interp(target, vals[j - 1:j + 1], grid[j - 1:j + 1]))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cross, manual, rtol=0, atol=1e-12)
